text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Hang in there, me! Hang in there...!! Run faster, run... stake it all!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I will deliver...
victory to everyone...!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
……!! Buena Vista……
Why is she being so desperate—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...No. That's... how she always was, wasn't it?
She was always... like that.
That's why I...――

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If you wanna cheer, speak up already!
I'm gonna cross the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
...Buena Vistaaa!
Go for ittttttt!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaa! It's Buena Vista!
The reigning strongest Tiara Umamusume was the strongest Umamusume of all!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (...If I listen closely, I can hear it clearly.)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chaaan!
Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaa!
Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san...!
Thank goodness...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah.
It's all reaching me..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*, *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thank you so much for your support!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista shouted at the top of her lungs to convey her gratitude.
As if in response to her heartfelt words...
the cheers from the crowd grew even louder.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...I won!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness...
I managed to run all the way to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! 
I'm so, so glad...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I supported her trembling shoulders as she broke down in tears.
She must have been terrified deep down... Yet, having shown us such a magnificent victory, she was—
choice_data_list: You're amazing, Buena. You really are incredible—
You're amazing, Buena. You truly are incredible—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I understand now.
What you were trying to tell me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's not like everything was a mistake.
We really have been building it up step by step, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right now... I can feel everyone's hearts even closer than before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So... let's go, Trainer.
Let's dive straight into it just like this!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's voices and expectations...!
Onward to the stage of dreams...!
choice_data_list: Let's see... the breathtaking view at the "Japan Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing all our preparations,
as we were heading back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san!
Trainer-saaann!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
I finally caught up with you~
choice_data_list: You caught up...? But didn't you get a head start?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Honestly, I was planning
to wait for Buena-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There were some delicious-looking food stalls, so...
I couldn't help myself... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It wasn't just because I was starving!
Seeing Buena-san's amazing run used up a lot of my energy...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Buena-san,
congratulations on winning the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a race I won as well,
I'm twice as happy, somehow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I could hear your cheers too, Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Were you waiting for me just...
to celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, that's part of it too!
But..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I was hoping to talk with you
for a bit, Buena-san..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's totally okay if you want to head back ahead of me, you know?
choice_data_list: Because both of them tend to get lost easily.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We should definitely be safe here~.
Jeez... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Buena-san's Trainer is her childhood friend, right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can tell they're super close after all...
and have complete trust in each other!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right.
We'll be together forever!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"The reason you run, Buena-san...
is that also for the sake of... your Trainer after all?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"My dream... is for the two of us to reach
that magnificent view Spe-san showed us
at the Japan Cup that day."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's hopes on my shoulders, just like Spe-san.
I'll definitely make it there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I cherished them dearly!
The expectations, my two moms, and the feelings
of the rivals I fought alongside with...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But... there were moments when it was solely for myself, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight,
my feelings grew sharper and sharper..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win!" "I'm going to win!"
"I am the number one Umamusume in Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I'm going to prove that Japanese Umamusume are strong!" ...Driven by that alone, she ran the whole way through.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe that feeling deep inside...
that 'I' want to do it, was my engine all along."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Feelings... buried deep inside.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Buena-san is truly happy from the bottom
of her heart... to carry everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
However, if you were to strip all that away...
what would be most precious to you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you were to run solely for yourself... what would give you strength?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing, Buena! So amazing, so amazing...!
Your running is truly—so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing, Buena! So amazing, so amazing...!
Your running is truly—so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Buena, it's okay.
...Let's go home together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing, Buena.
You really are amazing—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You are amazing, Buena.
You truly are amazing—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Let's go see the 'breathtaking view'—together, the two of us."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I think it's wonderful... to run for the sake of those feelings!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding, ehehe.
Was I acting a bit too much like a senior?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
I'm truly blessed to have such dependable seniors."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: In the Japan Cup, I'll run a race that reaches even Spe-san's heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please do come.
To witness our—breathtaking view.
